scripts.lint: eslint apps/api packages scripts *.js && npm run lint --workspace @marthub/web
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages scripts e2e *.js package.json README.md .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages scripts e2e *.js package.json README.md .github

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @marthub/contracts && node scripts/check-js.js && npm run build --workspace @marthub/web
